purpose: Replay every tidal-gate-memory formula with eight lens-geometry starts so apparent root failures and raw-RMS changes can be separated from optimizer behavior.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the tidal-gate-memory bridge fits.
No gravity constant is fitted to raw lensing; only lens geometry, shear, centers, and source positions are reoptimized.
This is a numerical robustness replay on already inspected clusters, not an external holdout.
All 24 rows are replayed because shallow root failures were common in preceding stages.
The mixed axisymmetric-galaxy/spherical-cluster closure remains a proxy rather than a common map-based tensor theory.
